name: Osmaura
long_description:
We are the front door to quality legal services for businesses. We identify when a company may need legal help, connect it with the right specialized firm, and manage the client experience from intake through future matters.

We grew 0 -> 17.5k MRR in 5 weeks after launching.

Lawyers are trained to practice law - not to prospect, sell, and manage pipelines. We're here to help them grow while they focus on what they do best.
one_liner: AI-native managed legal services for businesses
